# Vendored JavaScript

- `stimulus.js`: @hotwired/stimulus 3.2.2 (MIT, © Basecamp, LLC), the ES module build from jsDelivr.
  Vendored so the X-Ray console works in any host app without importmap or controllers.json changes.
- `../fonts/inter-latin-wght-normal.woff2`: Inter 4 variable font, latin subset (SIL Open Font License 1.1,
  © The Inter Project Authors, see `../fonts/OFL.txt`), from the @fontsource-variable/inter 5.2.8 package.
  Used where Apple's SF Pro is not available.
